descriptionHtml:
Featuring a classic round neckline, ruffle sleeves and a belt design in the waist, this stunning?evening?dress is perfect for any wedding. The shimmery leave design also gives a romantic vibe. The evening dress is perfect for parties, cocktail, prom, homecoming, graduation, weddings, and any other formal affair!
